purpose: Define the evidence and locale gates required before an official occupation record may be promoted into the canonical exploration graph.

sources.license: CC BY 4.0; attribute the O*NET 30.3 Database and USDOL/ETA, link the licence, and indicate changes.
sources.promotionBlocker: O*NET alone cannot satisfy the six-direct-locale-label contract. It may be a cited identifier or English alias only after a reviewed multilingual canonical label packet exists.
sources.attribution: Contains information from the O*NET 30.3 Database, sponsored by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA), used under CC BY 4.0; changes indicated by OIYO.

sources.promotionBlocker: The official download flow and source snapshot must be recorded. ESCO does not supply the required Korean, Japanese, or Chinese direct labels, so it cannot independently promote an OIYO six-locale occupation record.
sources.attribution: Contains modified information from the European Commission's ESCO classification, used under CC BY 4.0.

sources.license: ILO copyright/request-to-reproduce status requires separate permission review.
sources.promotionBlocker: Do not copy labels, definitions, or mappings into canonical data until a reuse permission or an unambiguous applicable licence is recorded.

mappingPolicy.canonicalId: An OIYO occupation ID is stable and never becomes an external source identifier. Each external identifier is retained as a source-scoped alias.
mappingPolicy.dedupe: A proposed record must be compared with existing OIYO IDs, aliases, and labels before promotion. A many-to-one mapping needs an explicit rationale; an uncertain mapping stays staged.
mappingPolicy.workContext: Official taxonomy membership or skill relations do not infer an OIYO work-context example. Any such edge needs a separate reviewed, non-fit exploration rationale.
mappingPolicy.locale: All six OIYO locale labels (ko, en, ja, zh, fr, es) must be direct, reviewed strings. Machine translation, English fallback, or transliteration is not direct locale copy.
mappingPolicy.provenance: Every promoted record stores source ID, official version, source-scoped identifier, licence review, attribution text, changed-by-OIYO flag, review date, and mapping rationale.
mappingPolicy.safety: Occupation records support bounded exploration navigation only; they cannot express suitability, employability, hiring, admissions, income, medical, psychological, or legal conclusions.
